claim: equal ordered success-only usage-trace laws at every finite call horizon

excluded: provider probability validity or provider behavior
errors, retries, currency, cumulative cost or cumulative trace/work budgets
termination probability or infinite-run trace law
scope.interpretation: same final block is sufficient for every finite-horizon trace-law equality; different blocks are inconclusive, not a trace-law counterexample
scope.kernel_rule_precedence: first matching rule in supplied order, otherwise resolved-contract default
scope.observer: ordered call labels contain normalized resolved contract, integer input usage, and integer output usage; stop is a terminal state class
scope.oracle: declared finite rational conditional kernel; exact request, saturated contract ordinal, and retained complete-event history determine its distribution
scope.saturation_justification: kernel ordinal and complete-history event ordinal literals are at most 32; all values >=33 match the same rules
scope.semantics: successful model outcomes only; each response updates its result register and complete event history
